concepts.skill: Count small sets by touching each object
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: count small sets by touching each object; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.

concepts.skill: Count larger sets through 100 using organised groups
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: count larger sets through 100 using organised groups; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count a small set one object at a time and say how many there are.

concepts.skill: Match quantities to numeral and picture
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: match quantities to numeral and picture; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count the small sets used for matching and recognize the corresponding numerals.

concepts.skill: Bundle tens and identify leftover ones
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: bundle tens and identify leftover ones; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count ten objects and see that a bundle still contains ten.

concepts.skill: Build and decompose numbers through 100; represent 100 as ten tens and one hundred
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Build and decompose numbers through 100; represent 100 as ten tens and one hundred. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Build one ten and count the loose ones before extending the range.

concepts.skill: Read and write numerals through 100
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Read and write numerals through 100. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Match numerals and quantities in the range being taught.

concepts.skill: Read and write number names through 100
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Read and write number names through 100. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Say and recognize the number names in the range being taught.

concepts.skill: Pair objects across sets to compare quantities
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: pair objects across sets to compare quantities; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Pair objects one to one in the two small sets being compared.

concepts.skill: Compare three sets using counts
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: compare three sets using counts; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count each of the sets in the task and compare the counts.

concepts.skill: Compare two numerals using place value
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: compare two numerals using place value; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Match quantities and numerals in the current range. Use tens and ones as two-digit examples are introduced.

concepts.skill: Arrange several numbers in increasing and decreasing order
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: arrange several numbers in increasing and decreasing order; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Compare two numbers in the current range before arranging several.

concepts.skill: Find counting-sequence rules, including steps of five
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Find counting-sequence rules, including steps of five. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count and order terms in the selected span and direction.

concepts.skill: Complete missing terms in increasing or decreasing sequences
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: complete missing terms in increasing or decreasing sequences; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Continue a short example of the pattern used in the task.

concepts.skill: Identify positions from first through tenth
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: identify positions from first through tenth; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count positions in a short line from a stated starting end, extending through tenth.

concepts.skill: Read, write and match ordinal words and symbols to positions
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Read, write and match ordinal words and symbols to positions. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.

concepts.skill: Split and recombine small quantities using number bonds
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: split and recombine small quantities using number bonds; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count and recount the small sets being split and recombined. For the introductory unit, use quantities through 10.

concepts.skill: Model joining and part-whole addition
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: model joining and part-whole addition; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Combine two small groups and count the total.

concepts.skill: Model removal and comparison subtraction
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: model removal and comparison subtraction; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count the small sets used in the removal or comparison.

concepts.skill: Write or complete equations for addition and subtraction situations
concepts.assessment: Independently write or complete equations for a joining situation and a subtraction situation, using +, − and = correctly. Match each equation to the quantities in the situation.
concepts.readiness_check: Show the joining or subtraction action in the situation before recording it.

concepts.skill: Use the equals sign to show that two quantities have the same value
concepts.assessment: Independently complete a true equation with an expression on each side and explain or show why the sides have equal value.
concepts.readiness_check: Compare the values of the two sides using small quantities or concrete models.

concepts.skill: Build related addition and subtraction equations
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: build related addition and subtraction equations; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Read or build one related addition and subtraction equation using the quantities in the task.

concepts.skill: Find a missing part using inverse relationships
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: find a missing part using inverse relationships; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Show how joining the parts and removing one part relate in a small example.

concepts.skill: Combine three or more single-digit addends using helpful groupings
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: combine three or more single-digit addends using helpful groupings; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Combine two small groups before adding a third.

concepts.skill: Add and subtract within 20
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: add and subtract within 20; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Represent the task quantities through 20 and demonstrate joining or removal with smaller numbers.

concepts.skill: Add and subtract within 100 without regrouping, including zero
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Add and subtract within 100 without regrouping, including zero. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Find the tens and ones in the operands used in the task.

concepts.skill: Add and subtract within 100 with regrouping
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: add and subtract within 100 with regrouping; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Trade ten ones for a ten or a ten for ten ones using the quantities in the task.

concepts.skill: Carry out the written place-value addition algorithm with and without regrouping
concepts.assessment: Independently add within 100 using the written place-value algorithm in one example with regrouping and one without. Show aligned places, any exchange and the resulting sum.
concepts.readiness_check: Represent the addends as tens and ones and show an exchange for a regrouping example.

concepts.skill: Carry out the written place-value subtraction algorithm with and without regrouping
concepts.assessment: Independently subtract within 100 using the written place-value algorithm in one example with regrouping and one without. Show aligned places, any exchange and the nonnegative difference.
concepts.readiness_check: Represent the starting number as tens and ones and show an exchange for a regrouping example.

concepts.skill: Calculate mentally within 20
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: calculate mentally within 20; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Show a strategy such as splitting a small quantity or making ten with a model.

concepts.skill: Add and subtract ones from two-digit numbers without regrouping
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: add and subtract ones from two-digit numbers without regrouping; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Identify the ones in the two-digit number and change them without regrouping.

concepts.skill: Add and subtract tens from two-digit numbers mentally
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: add and subtract tens from two-digit numbers mentally; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Identify the tens and ones in the two-digit numbers used in the task.

concepts.skill: Build equal groups and repeated sums
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: build equal groups and repeated sums; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Build and count a few small equal groups.

concepts.skill: Share equally and make groups of a given size
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: share equally and make groups of a given size; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count the small collection to be shared or grouped.

concepts.skill: Represent equal groups with multiplication notation
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: represent equal groups with multiplication notation; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Identify the number of groups and the number in each group in the example.

concepts.skill: Solve multiplication situations with products at most 40
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: solve multiplication situations with products at most 40; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Build a small example of equal groups and record it with multiplication notation.

concepts.skill: Solve equal sharing and grouping situations with dividends at most 20
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: solve equal sharing and grouping situations with dividends at most 20; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Share or group a small collection evenly before extending the dividend range.

concepts.skill: Count Singapore cent denominations to one dollar
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: count Singapore cent denominations to one dollar; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Recognize and tally the cent denominations in the collection being counted.

concepts.skill: Count whole-dollar denominations to 100 dollars
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: count whole-dollar denominations to 100 dollars; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Recognize and tally the whole-dollar denominations in the collection being counted.

concepts.skill: Align a ruler at zero and measure in centimetres
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: align a ruler at zero and measure in centimetres; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count equal intervals on a short strip, starting at zero.

concepts.skill: Use cm when recording a length
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: Use cm when recording a length. Use a fresh example and show reasoning when appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Recognize a length measurement made in centimetres.

concepts.skill: Compare and order lengths recorded in centimetres
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: compare and order lengths recorded in centimetres; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Compare the numerals on the provided centimetre measurements.

concepts.skill: Use a ruler to read a line segment’s length to the nearest centimetre

concepts.skill: Draw a segment to a specified whole centimetre using a ruler
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: draw a segment to a specified whole centimetre using a ruler; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.

concepts.skill: Read hour and minute hands
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: read hour and minute hands; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.

concepts.skill: Read clock times in five-minute increments
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: read clock times in five-minute increments; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Count by fives around a clock face from 0 to 60.

concepts.skill: Choose and use am or pm for familiar times of day

concepts.skill: Interpret and use h and min labels
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: interpret and use h and min labels; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Distinguish an hour from a minute using familiar durations.

concepts.skill: Determine a half-hour interval
concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: determine a half-hour interval; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
concepts.readiness_check: Follow the movement of the hands during a half turn of the minute hand.

concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: identify constituent shapes in composite pictures; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.

concepts.assessment: Independently demonstrate: copy figures on dot grids; use a fresh example and explain or show a strategy where appropriate.
